question: What transparency commitments do signatories of the General-Purpose AI Code of Practice undertake?
text:
Based on the provided documents, the corpus does not contain the text of the General-Purpose AI Code of Practice itself, nor does it list the specific transparency commitments its signatories undertake. The documents instead describe the framework and objectives for such codes.

The documents state that codes of practice should "clearly set out their specific objectives and contain commitments or measures, including key performance indicators as appropriate, to ensure the achievement of those objectives" [ai-act#art_56(4)]. They also require that "participants to the codes of practice report regularly to the AI Office on the implementation of the commitments and the measures taken and their outcomes, including as measured against the key performance indicators as appropriate" [ai-act#art_56(5)].

Regarding transparency for general-purpose AI models more broadly, the corpus notes that "proportionate transparency measures should be laid down, including the drawing up and keeping up to date of documentation, and the provision of information on the general-purpose AI model for its usage by the downstream providers," with technical documentation to be made available "upon request, to the AI Office and the national competent authorities" [ai-act#rct_101]. The corpus also mentions that codes of practice are a "central tool for the proper compliance with the obligations provided for under this Regulation for providers of general-purpose AI models" and that providers "should be able to rely on codes of practice to demonstrate compliance with the obligations" [ai-act#rct_117].
